source: M. Hiroki, N. Maeda and N. Kobayashi, J. Cryst. Growth 237-239, 956 (2002), doi:10.1016/S0022-0248(01)02020-6. Fig. 3: AlGaN thickness dependence of the 2DEG density of AlGaN/GaN heterostructures with Al compositions of 25, 35 and 45 percent, at room temperature. Fig. 2(a): Al composition dependence of the 2DEG density for 40 nm AlGaN barriers at room temperature and at 77 K.
structure_from_text: MOVPE on sapphire; GaN layer 2-3 um; undoped AlGaN barrier (the 5 percent sample of Fig. 2 is Si doped and is not used); no cap layer is mentioned; Hall effect at room temperature and 77 K.

relaxation_from_text.x0.35_85nm: relaxed (elongated AlGaN spot in the reciprocal space map, Fig. 4b); degree not given
relaxation_from_text.x0.25_95nm: relaxation observed (reciprocal space map); degree not given
relaxation_from_text.x0.45_40nm: relaxed (text discussing Fig. 2); degree not given
relaxation_from_text.note: The authors define the critical thickness as the thickness at which Ns starts to decrease. The last 25 percent point of Fig. 3 is plotted on the right frame at about 90 nm; the text gives 95 nm for the sample whose map shows relaxation.

method: Page 4 (Fig. 3) and page 3 (Fig. 2a) of the published PDF rendered at 300 dpi with pdftoppm. Axes calibrated on the major tick marks (Fig. 3: 6.49 px per nm, 31.45 px per 1e12 cm^-2; Fig. 2a: 8.80 px per percent, 20.53 px per 1e12 cm^-2). Symbol centres are the bounding-box centres of the connected dark regions after a morphological opening that removes the connecting lines; open circles are hole-filled first. Read with two thresholds (128 and 90 of 255); the two readings agree within 0.05e12 cm^-2 and 0.1 nm. The opening trims the tips of the triangles, which moves their centres by up to about 0.2e12 cm^-2. Estimated reading uncertainty 0.3e12 cm^-2.
notes: The 40 nm, x = 0.35 sample of Fig. 2a (16.0e12) and the 40 nm point of Fig. 3 (18.3e12) differ by 2.3e12; the paper does not say whether they are the same sample. This difference is taken as an indication of the sample-to-sample scatter.
At 40 nm the room-temperature density exceeds the 77 K density by a factor 1.39 (x = 0.25) and 1.34 (x = 0.35).

fig4b_map_85nm_x0.35.method: Page 4 rendered at 600 dpi. Axes calibrated on the tick marks (Qx: 47.5, 48.0, 48.5, 49.0 at 535.3 px per 1e-2 rlu; Qy: 59.0-60.5 at 516.5 px per 1e-2 rlu). The dark pixels of the AlGaN contours were collected in the box Qy = 60.05-60.35, excluding the dashed pseudomorphic line (+-3 px) and the arrow. The relaxation scale uses only Qx, which is proportional to 1/a: R = (Qx - Qx_GaN) / (Qx_GaN (a_GaN / a_AlGaN - 1)), with a_GaN = 3.189 and a(Al0.35Ga0.65N) = 3.162 angstrom (Vegard, Vurgaftman and Meyer lattice constants).
fig4b_map_85nm_x0.35.reading: The AlGaN contours are centred on the pseudomorphic line and extend on both sides by about 0.17-0.20 of the full-relaxation distance; the authors' arrow marks the elongation towards relaxation. The average relaxation is therefore at most about 0.2.
